editorial.blurb: Lucy's serves some of Chicago's best fried chicken and smashburgers at casual prices, with a fun neighborhood vibe and genuinely great execution across the board.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the fried chicken sandwich with fries—you'll get a huge portion that easily serves two, and at $18 before tip it's an incredible value; the signature sauce is essential.

topDishes.note: Crispy breading that shatters, packed with chicken, signature sauce is a standout
Perfectly balanced bun, patty, pickles, and onions create an incredibly flavorful bite
Huge Five Guys–esque portions, fresh and consistently excellent
